workflow.title: Daily unresolved alerts digest to #oncall and critical-unacknowledged escalation
workflow.goal: Each run: read the alerts sheet, post a digest of all unresolved alerts (with severity and service) to the #oncall channel, and if any unresolved critical alert has not been acknowledged for at least one hour, email the requester directly naming each such alert.

assumptions: The run is started every morning at 8:00 by an external scheduler and receives the current time as input.now.
The Slack stand-in channel is named #oncall.
The escalation email goes to the requester's own address, requester@example.test, as the user asked.
The one-hour check is evaluated at each run, so a critical alert is escalated at the first run after it has been unacknowledged for an hour.
risks: Escalation only happens when the flow runs; if the schedule is missed, overdue critical alerts are not emailed until the next run.
chat.post and outbox.send are non-idempotent and are attempted only once; a failed post needs manual re-run.
Outbound messages require a person's approval when the flow runs live.
successCriteria: The digest lists every alert with resolved=false, including severity and service, and is posted once to #oncall.
Every critical alert with acknowledged=false, resolved=false and age of at least one hour is named by id and service in exactly one email to the requester.
No email is sent when no critical alert is overdue.

nodes.description: Keep alerts that are not resolved.
Render one line per unresolved alert with severity and service.
Re-read #oncall and confirm the digest post is there.
Compute hours since each alert was raised.
Keep critical alerts unacknowledged for at least one hour.
Render one line per overdue critical alert naming its id, service, message, age and raise time.

metadata.rationale: Digest is built from the alerts sheet with deterministic filters. The escalation applies the one-hour age rule to unacknowledged critical alerts and names each overdue alert in the email body and subject count. Both outbound actions are verified by independent re-read.
